harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the requested Prometheus/Thanos monitoring service. Both Prometheus replicas scrape all four hosts, Thanos deduplicates them on node3:10902, persisted history is queryable from object storage, single-replica failures preserve queries, and every node recovered after a verified reboot.
actions_performed: Deployed Prometheus and Thanos sidecars on node1 and node2 with distinct replica labels.
Deployed node_exporter on all four nodes and configured both Prometheus replicas to scrape every host.
Deployed Thanos Query, Store Gateway, and Compactor on node3.
Deployed an authenticated TLS MinIO object store on node4:9000 with bucket thanos-metrics under /srv/thanos-objectstore.
Tested failure and restoration of each Prometheus replica independently.
Verified historical queries through a temporary query endpoint connected only to the Store Gateway.
Safely rebooted node1, node2, node3, and node4 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Independent Prometheus replicas collect metrics from all four systems
evidence.summary: Both replicas and sidecars are active after restarts; each Prometheus reports node1-node4 targets up and has its distinct replica label.

evidence.requirement: Thanos query, store, and compaction services run on node3
evidence.summary: All node3 Thanos services are active, required ports are listening, both sidecars and Store Gateway have no errors, and 11 persisted blocks are loaded.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated HTTPS object store on node4:9000 with required bucket and data path
evidence.summary: The thanos-metrics bucket exists under /srv/thanos-objectstore, TLS health succeeds, authenticated access works, unauthenticated access returns 403, and data persisted across reboot.

evidence.requirement: Object-store access variables exist on node3
evidence.summary: The required environment file exists at /root/thanos-objectstore.env with root ownership and mode 0600.

evidence.requirement: Queries on node3:10902 deduplicate replicas
evidence.summary: The deduplicated query returns four host series, while dedup=false returns eight series—one from each replica for every host.

evidence.requirement: Queries remain available when node1 Prometheus is unavailable
evidence.summary: With node1 Prometheus and sidecar inactive, node3 still returned all four host series through node2; node1 was then restored.

evidence.requirement: Queries remain available when node2 Prometheus is unavailable
evidence.summary: With node2 Prometheus and sidecar inactive, node3 still returned all four host series through node1; node2 was then restored.

evidence.requirement: Historical results are retained in object storage
evidence.summary: The Store Gateway loaded persisted blocks with a finite historical range; a store-only historical query returned all four host series with the Store Gateway as its sole backend.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline and TSDB data were recorded, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed, and Prometheus, sidecar, node_exporter, TSDB blocks, and queries recovered.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline and TSDB data were recorded, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed, and Prometheus, sidecar, node_exporter, TSDB blocks, and queries recovered.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy Thanos baseline was recorded, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed, and query/store/compact, loaded blocks, credentials, deduplication, and full membership recovered.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart persistence
evidence.summary: Healthy TLS object-store baseline was recorded, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed, and MinIO, node_exporter, bucket contents, authentication, and stored data recovered.
